headlines.title: Two Analog Chip Stocks Buoy Philadelphia Semiconductor Index
headlines.summary: Two analog chip stocks rose Monday and helped to offset losses among AI and PC chip stocks on the SOX index.

headlines.title: MPWR Q3 deep dive: diversified end-market demand and design wins drive outlook upgrade
headlines.summary: Power management chips maker Monolithic Power Systems (NASDAQ:MPWR) reported Q3 2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 63.1% year on year to $1.20 billion. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($1.35 billion at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 10.2% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $8.19 per share was 5.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

headlines.title: Revenue Outlook Raised Could Be A Game Changer For Monolithic Power Systems Stock
headlines.summary: Monolithic Power Systems reported record Q3 2026 revenue of US$1.2b and net income of US$271.1m, alongside Q4 revenue guidance of US$1.315b to US$1.385b and updated long term capacity plans. The business paired this performance with over US$450m of share repurchases and an increased focus on enterprise data, automotive, and industrial power solutions, while reshaping its finance leadership team.

headlines.title: Why Monolithic Power Systems (MPWR) Is Getting Attention Today
headlines.summary: Monolithic Power Systems (MPWR) just cleared a key milestone, reporting third quarter revenue above US$1.2b and issuing fresh fourth quarter sales guidance alongside a reshuffle in its senior finance team. Monolithic Power Systems shares have swung around earnings, with a 1-day share price return of 1.07% and a 7-day gain of 6.27%. However, the stock is still down 10.06% over 30 days and 15.03% over 90 days, while the year-to-date share price return of 29.

headlines.title: MPWR Q3 Earnings Call Highlights AI Demand and Capacity Expansion
headlines.summary: Monolithic Power raises its 2026 enterprise data growth outlook amid surging AI demand, capacity expansion and opportunities in communications and automotive.

description: Monolithic Power Systems, Inc. provides semiconductor-based power electronics solutions in China, Taiwan, South Korea, Southeast Asia, Europe, the United States, Japan, and internationally. The company offers direct current (DC) to DC solutions to convert and control voltages within a range of electronic systems, such as cloud-based and on-premises CPU servers and workstations, AI systems, memory, storage solutions, notebooks, infotainment, power sources, home appliances, network infrastructure, and satellite communications. It also provides alternating current (AC) to DC; driver metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistors; power management integrated circuits (ICs); and current limit switch and lighting control products. The company serves storage and computing, enterprise data, automotive, communications, consumer, and industrial end markets through third-party distributors and value-added resellers. Monolithic Power Systems, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is based in West Palm Beach, Florida.
